name: Arc Kovalenko-Ogawa
role: Numbers runner and bookmaker's courier for an illegal betting operation in Shallowgrave
location: Shallowgrave — lives in a bunk hostel on Carrion Alley, works the market corridors between the Sump and Ironvein, near Western and Division
description:
Arc Kovalenko-Ogawa is nineteen years old and moves like she expects the ground to give way. She's thin in the way of someone whose calories are unreliable, with close-cropped natural hair dyed in two bands — natural black at the roots, then a vivid synthetic orange at the tips — and a set of geneware cat ears she bought secondhand with three months of saved wages; they're tawny gold and slightly too large for her head, which she is sensitive about. Her skin is a warm dark brown, her eyes quick and dark, her grin infectious and slightly desperate. She has a long scar across her left shin from a close call with a Ferrogate transit barrier she vaulted at full speed.

She is fast — genuinely, almost recklessly fast — and has built her entire professional identity around it. She runs bets and payouts for a bookmaker named Sołtys Kowalczyk-Fanuanuu who she calls 'the Old Man,' carrying chips, physical slips, and occasionally small packages she's been told not to think about through the market crowds. She is saving money for something she hasn't named yet but pictures vaguely as 'away.' She is not cynical about this. She still believes in the vagueness of away.

core_fears: Being caught and processed into the Ferrogate labor pool — she's heard what happens
That 'away' doesn't exist, that everywhere is Shallowgrave
core_desires: To be genuinely fast enough that nothing can catch her — metaphorically and literally
coping_mechanisms: Physical exertion — she runs even when she doesn't have to
Humor as deflection; she makes everything a joke before it can make her feel something
blind_spots: Believes she can exit this life cleanly when she has enough saved; doesn't understand how networks make that complicated
Trusts the Old Man more than she should because he's been kind to her
psychology.secret: She memorizes every slip she carries — bet amounts, account codes, client identifiers — and has been quietly building a mental ledger of the operation's full financial structure. She doesn't know why yet. It feels like insurance. It is also incredibly dangerous.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Shallowgrave Creole mixed with market slang; fast, clipped, word-economical
speech_patterns.cadence: Rapid and skipping, sentences often abandoned halfway and restarted
example_lines: 'Okay so — listen, right? I'm not saying it's a problem. I'm saying it's a situation. Tight situation. But I've run tighter, yeah?'
'The Old Man's good for it. He's always good for it. He likes me. Right, okay, everyone likes me until they don't, but — he actually does.'

story_hooks: Yusra picked up a slip-pack that contained something that absolutely was not a betting slip — and now someone is following her and the Old Man isn't answering
She's been offered triple her rate to make one delivery to a location in Ironvein that all her instincts say is wrong, and she's trying to decide if 'away' is worth it
narrative_function: Street-level information source — she sees everything and everyone moving money in Shallowgrave; useful contact, sympathetic viewpoint character, person who can be in danger or can witness something she shouldn't have
augmentations: Secondhand geneware cat ears (tawny gold, cosmetic); a cheap adrenal spike implant in her left arm that she activates before difficult runs (low-grade, sketchy provenance)
daily_life: She picks up her slip-pack from a dead-drop in a drainage grate at 0800, runs the circuit through three market sectors until midday, breaks for whatever food she can afford, runs the afternoon payout circuit, and returns to the hostel by 2100 unless something goes wrong.
affiliation: Works for Sołtys Kowalczyk-Fanuanuu's illegal bookmaking operation; no gang loyalty

decision_rules: Don't open the packages — she's repeated this to herself so many times it's become a kind of prayer she's starting to doubt
If something feels wrong, find an exit before confirming it's wrong
escalation_ladder: Physical distance — literally moves away from the source of stress
Disappears for days; resurfaces when she thinks it's blown over

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Bright, fast, slightly manic friendliness that functions as a screen
interpersonal_modes.friends: Still fast and bright but with real warmth underneath; will give her last meal to someone she trusts

stress_responses.medium: Goes quiet suddenly, which people who know her recognize as alarming

contradictions: Claims not to care about anyone in Shallowgrave while knowing every vendor's name, every sick kid, every new face
Insists the cat ears are 'just a look' but visibly brightens when someone compliments them
habits: Checks exit routes when entering any space, automatically
Leaves a found object — bottle cap, wire scrap — at a storm-drain E.L.F. shrine she calls 'the Under-Saint' before difficult runs
breaking_points: Learning the Old Man knowingly sent her into a dangerous situation without warning
Being trapped somewhere with no exits — triggers full panic

cyberware_inventory.name: Geneware cat ears (secondhand, tawny gold, cosmetic)
cyberware_inventory.description: Geneware cat ears (secondhand, tawny gold, cosmetic)

physical_description.heritage: Eastern European (38.8%), Hispanic/Latin American (37.9%), and East Asian (23.3%) — a diaspora blend. Her features reflect this tri-continental mix: Eastern European bone structure provides angular definition, Hispanic/Latin American ancestry contributes warm golden undertones and depth, while East Asian heritage shapes her eye geometry and high cheekbone prominence. The genetic convergence creates a warm medium-brown complexion with subtle amber and honey undertones.
physical_description.build: Wiry and lean with the taut musculature of someone who runs constantly; no body fat to spare. Her frame reads as hungry but functional — built for speed rather than strength.
physical_description.hair_color: Natural black at roots, synthetic neon orange at tips
physical_description.hair_style: Close-cropped, almost shaved at the sides, longer on top with the dyed orange tips visible
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm medium brown with golden and honey undertones, reflecting the balanced blend of Eastern European, Hispanic/Latin American, and East Asian ancestry; sun-warmed despite industrial corridor pallor
physical_description.complexion: Angular face with high, pronounced cheekbones shaped by Eastern European and East Asian heritage, warmed by the depth of Hispanic/Latin American complexion. Skin bears the slight texture of Shallowgrave's industrial air quality. Quick, infectious grin lines around her mouth. Her expression defaults to watchful and slightly tensed.
distinguishing_marks: Long horizontal scar across the left shin from a Ferrogate transit barrier vault gone close, pale and slightly raised
A faint discoloration around the injection site on her left forearm where the adrenal spike implant sits beneath the skin
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Secondhand geneware cat ears (tawny gold, slightly oversized relative to her head, with visible seams and older biotech aesthetic). The ears twitch slightly when she's focused or nervous. Left forearm shows a faint subcutaneous bulge where the adrenal spike implant sits — visible only under direct light or when her arm is flexed.
physical_description.posture_movement: She moves with coiled readiness, weight always balanced on the balls of her feet. Her gait is economical and fast even when she's not running. Her head turns frequently, tracking movement in her peripheral vision. When still, she fidgets — fingers drumming, weight shifting. There's an underlying desperation in her movement, masked by practiced speed.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 4 working-class courier aesthetic. Black synthetic runner's jacket with reflective threading (worn, patches at the elbows). Fitted dark gray compression pants with cargo pockets for slip-packs and chips. Worn synth-leather ankle boots with grip-soles rated for market floor surfaces. A faded teal hoodie underneath, visible at the collar. No jewelry except a cheap digital wrist-timer for tracking run schedules. Her clothes are functional, slightly too large in places (hand-me-down hostel-trade economy), and bear the wear of constant movement through crowded, grimy corridors.
